usageNote: became available就是'变得可以接触到'，用在偶像突然现身或内容发布，超级常见！

examples.en: The singer became available to his fans after the concert for autographs.
examples.zh: 演唱会结束后，这位歌手向粉丝们开放了签名环节。

examples.en: His new album became available to his fans on streaming platforms last Friday.
examples.zh: 他的新专辑上周五在流媒体平台向粉丝开放收听了。
